news.text: Suspected dislocation of the left shoulder for #Conceição: tests in the coming hours. He risks a month out. #Juventus @Gazzetta_it[Giovanni Albanese]

CRUSHED#Lazio firstAfter 9 years, the biancocelesti conquer the Stadium: #Inter caught at 19 points.#Juve vanished: 0-3 and boos. #Gattuso puts Lucio in trouble.#Spalletti at -8 points from the top after 7 matchdays: many fans left before the end. "Heart and mind are needed". #Provstgaard breaks the deadlock. Crossbar by #Tavares. In the second half, goals from #Isaksen and #DeleBashiru.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

NO HEART, NO RESPECT#Juve-#Lazio 0-3#Gattuso, what a lesson: he is first with #Inter! Bianconeri humiliated: the Stadium boos.#Provstgaard, #Isaksen and #DeleBashiru punish the bianconeri, who were disastrous from every point of view. The 11 points in 7 matchdays and the 8th place put everyone under scrutiny. #Spalletti: "I am surprised too, I didn't like certain attitudes". #Bremer very harsh: "I'm not pointing fingers, but there are people who hide. I cannot carry everyone in my arms". Rino's masterpiece: #Lazio has never had such a good start. [Front Page TuttoSport]

🎙Gleison #Bremer on @SkySport:PLAYERS' RESPONSIBILITY"You are right in the first thing you said: the coach gives instructions, but in the end we are the ones who go onto the pitch.But we are 11 players plus 5 subs.I cannot carry everyone in my arms, I can speak, I can lend a hand, but everyone has their own character, I can only go so far.There are those with more character and those with less, there are those who feel the boos and perhaps get scared.If you compare it to the #Juventus of a few years ago, it is different, that weighs on you."PLAYERS NOT MEASURING UP"Yes, yes, I said that, but I am not pointing fingers at the guys. Almost exactly one year after #Tudor's dismissal (October 27, 2025) Luciano #Spalletti's mission at the helm of #Juventus has turned out to be a failure: first the failure to qualify for the Champions League, now the disappointing start to the league season (11 points in 7 matchdays). Fatality of fate: last year, a defeat against #Lazio was exactly what prompted #Comolli to change the manager…[Nico Schira]
"Noi pronti per le sabbie mobili"(We are ready for quicksand)

A rain of boos at the Stadium directed at #Juventus which collapses at home, losing 3-0 against #Lazio and by Mid-October, they are already at -8 from the top and out of the Scudetto race for the seventh consecutive year.[Nico Schira]
